title: LabelScan Extraction Pipeline Envelope (v1)
description: The in-process state object passed between extraction-pipeline stages (the 'agents') inside the Ingestion & Extraction context of the LabelScan modular monolith. This is a CONTRACT artifact, not application code. It is NOT a wire/event payload and is NOT persisted as-is; persisted facts (raw artifact, ExtractionRun, audit entries) and published events (LabelExtractionCompleted, ExtractionFlaggedForReview) are defined elsewhere (ARCHITECTURE.md section 6, ADR-0003/0005). The envelope's job is to (a) carry correlation_id/trace_id/ingestion_id through every stage, (b) accumulate per-stage results WITHOUT silently dropping any required-context field, and (c) carry security flags for hostile-content handling. NO stage may delete or overwrite another stage's result; stages only append their own block. Required-context fields (see required_context_keys) must be present and non-empty before a stage that depends on them runs; their absence is a hard halt + escalate, never a silent truncation.

envelope_version.description: Version of THIS envelope contract. Bumped on any breaking change to the envelope shape. Independent of the extraction prompt/schema version (seafood-label-extraction/v1.0.0).

ids.description: Identity + observability ids carried unchanged through every stage (constraint #8). correlation_id and trace_id are populated by the platform middleware and MUST never be regenerated mid-pipeline; the async worker reads them off the event envelope so the trace stays connected across the queue hop (BACKEND section 10.3).

trace_id.description: W3C trace id; per-stage spans are children of it.

span_id.description: Current stage's span id; rotates per stage.

extraction_run_id.description: The ExtractionRun this pass belongs to. A new run id is minted on re-extraction (ADR-0003); the envelope never mutates a prior run.

status.description: Pipeline-level status, a superset/refinement of the Ingestion lifecycle (ARCHITECTURE section 2.1: raw_stored -> ocr_done -> extracted -> needs_review -> confirmed). Pipeline-internal failure states are explicit so the orchestrator can route. 'ocr_skipped_garbage' is the OCR-quality-gate short-circuit (cost saver, section 11). No status is ever silently set to a 'success' value while a required-context key is missing.

required_context_keys.description: The NO-SILENT-TRUNCATION guarantee, made data. This array lists the envelope paths that the NEXT stage to run declares as required-context. The orchestrator validates each listed key is present and non-empty BEFORE invoking that stage. If any is absent, the orchestrator sets status='halted_missing_context', emits log code PIPE_REQUIRED_CONTEXT_MISSING, writes an audit entry, and routes to the terminal fallback (review) - it does NOT proceed with partial context. Compression/summarization (section 5 of the main doc) may rewrite OPTIONAL keys but is forbidden from removing any key named here.

stage_results.description: Append-only map of per-stage outputs. Each stage writes exactly one entry keyed by its stage id and never edits another stage's entry (context-ownership rule). Absence of a key means that stage has not run (or was skipped); it is NOT an error by itself - the required_context_keys check is what enforces dependencies.

attempts.description: Per-stage attempt counters and circuit signals. Bounds the repair re-ask (LLM <=2 per PROMPT-CONTRACT section 7) and the OCR retry (<=3 per BACKEND section 9.1). Used to enforce hard exits and to populate logs (attempt field, section 9 of main doc).

security.description: Hostile-content handling state. OCR text and client meta are treated as untrusted external content (prompt injection, adversarial labels, incidental PII). Flags here drive quarantine and human-review routing (section 8 of main doc). Setting any blocking flag forces the human-review branch; flags are never cleared by an automated stage, only annotated.

flags.description: Stable security flag codes raised by any stage. Append-only.

quarantined.description: True if any blocking security flag was raised; a quarantined envelope cannot auto-confirm and must go to human review with the flag surfaced.

pii_redaction_applied.description: Whether the logging/redaction layer scrubbed suspected PII from log projections of this envelope (the envelope itself retains raw refs by ID, not inline PII).

provenance_refs.description: References (by ID, never inline blobs) to the immutable raw store and the audit trail, so the envelope stays small and the heavy artifacts live outside it (ADR-0003, ARCHITECTURE section 7.1). The envelope carries pointers; it is not the system of record.

raw_image_ref.description: Object-store content-addressed key + checksum ref for the raw image (written BEFORE OCR, ADR-0003).

raw_ocr_ref.description: raw_artifact id of the appended raw OCR provider JSON (geometry + per-token confidence). Null until OCR completes.

audit_entry_refs.description: IDs of audit entries written during this pipeline run (append-only, ADR-0004).

max.description: Hard ceiling (OCR=3, LLM repair re-ask=2). On count==max the stage takes its terminal fallback; the orchestrator never loops past this.

circuit_state.description: Per-provider breaker state mirrored from BACKEND section 9.3; when 'open' the stage is not called and status is set to *_failed/provider_degraded.

confidenceBand.description: Domain Confidence VO band (ADR-0005). The backend re-derives bands; the model's raw 0-1 score is a hint only.

image_ref.description: Ref to the image actually sent to OCR. NOTE: preprocessing NEVER overwrites the raw image (ADR-0003); a derived/enhanced image is a separate, non-authoritative artifact and the raw remains the evidence anchor.

applied.description: Operations applied (e.g. orientation, downscale). Empty array means pass-through (preprocessing is optional/skippable - it has a no-op fallback).

raw_ocr_ref.description: Mirrors provenance_refs.raw_ocr_ref; the raw OCR JSON is the evidence anchor for all downstream evidence-substring checks.

ocr_text.description: Plain extracted text. Treated as UNTRUSTED data downstream (never instructions).

verdict.description: 'skip_garbage' short-circuits the LLM (cost saver, section 11) and routes to review; 'proceed' continues to LLM extraction; 'review' forces human review without calling the LLM (e.g. suspected non-food image).

score.description: Composite OCR-quality score (mean token confidence + legible-token ratio + minimum content length). Threshold is a configurable domain value, not a scattered float.

schema_version.description: Must equal 'seafood-label-extraction/v1.0.0' for v1; the gate routes/validates per this value.

raw_output_ref.description: Ref to the stored raw LLM output (for calibration/debugging); never trusted as fields until the gate validates it.

schemaValidateResult.description: Output of the structural + no-fabrication gate (BACKEND section 8.2 steps 1-2). 'fields_coerced_null' are values whose evidence was absent or NOT an exact substring of the raw OCR - coerced to null with reason 'unverifiable' (never fabricated).

businessValidateResult.description: Output of the rule-set + confidence-threshold + controlled-vocab + GTIN checks (BACKEND section 8.2 steps 3-5, section 8.4). Validated against a VERSIONED rule-set SNAPSHOT (no live coupling); rule_set_version makes any decision explainable by the rules in force at the time.
